sonnet.problem: Card 9 re-asks the fact card 8 just covered. Card 8's answer is that God comforts us so we can comfort others with the comfort we received from God (1:4). Card 9 asks the same point again, whether that comfort came from us on our own.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
